evidenceScope: Official Burton product-page Personality labels and riding descriptions. The current pages use qualitative labels, not a common numeric flex score.
classificationMethod: terrain values are normalized from the manufacturer's product-specific use descriptions. When the manufacturer describes broad versatility rather than naming one terrain category, all-mountain is a classification inference; no terrain field is a rider-test result.

burton-cartel-re-flex-2027.manufacturerUseDescription: A balanced blend of comfort, control, and across-the-board compatibility; product copy describes versatility.
burton-cartel-re-flex-2027.normalizationNote: all-mountain is inferred from broad compatibility and versatility; the page does not name a specific terrain category.

burton-cartel-x-re-flex-2027.manufacturerUseDescription: Park laps, powder turns, groomers, and side hits; versatile across riding styles and conditions.

burton-freestyle-re-flex-2027.manufacturerUseDescription: Smooth and playful flex; groomers to natural features.
burton-freestyle-re-flex-2027.normalizationNote: freestyle is also reflected by the model name; freeride maps to the stated natural-feature use, not an independently tested specialty.

burton-genesis-re-flex-2027.manufacturerUseDescription: Responsive, cushioned binding for full days on the mountain and riders who push their gear and riding.

burton-lexa-x-est-2027.manufacturerUseDescription: The page explains the stiff category as suited to steep lines, carving, and higher-speed response; Lexa X offers quick, responsive control and is EST/Channel-only.
burton-lexa-x-est-2027.normalizationNote: terrain is mapped from the manufacturer’s stiff/aggressive flex explanation and product response claims, not a named Lexa X terrain list.

burton-mission-re-flex-2027.manufacturerUseDescription: The manufacturer calls Mission a do-it-all workhorse; its flex category is Happy Medium.

burton-step-on-genesis-re-flex-2027.manufacturerUseDescription: The Step On interface is described for taking on the entire mountain; the page says Genesis is made for full days on the mountain.

burton-step-on-re-flex-2027.manufacturerUseDescription: The page pairs Step On with all-mountain performance and says the interface is for taking on the entire mountain.

burton-step-on-re-flex-womens-2027.manufacturerUseDescription: The page pairs Step On with all-mountain performance and says the interface is for taking on the entire mountain.

limits: Burton qualitative Personality labels are not converted into numeric ratings.
Manufacturer descriptions are positioning claims, not independent field tests.
EST-only bindings remain limited to boards with Burton The Channel; Step On bindings remain compatible only with Step On boots as stated on their product pages.
